stories.title: 'Radiation fears' on site of new housing development
stories.summary: Part of the site was used to 'bash, burn and bury' planes, which could have left some contamination.

stories.title: My 12 year-old prefers kettlebells to social media
stories.summary: Robyn is more interested in what her body can do than how it looks, her mum says.

stories.title: Further charge after officer shot in city centre
stories.summary: PC Lee Lane was shot in the foot after approaching two suspects in Angel Row on 18 October.

stories.title: Doctor was 'misled' by circumcised boy's mother
stories.summary: A boy was circumcised without his father's knowledge after the mother said she had sole responsibility.

stories.title: Six in court accused of high-value Pokemon card theft
stories.summary: Six men have been charged in connection with the theft of high-value Pokemon cards from a warehouse.

stories.title: Man slashed friend with knife after football row
stories.summary: Police say the victim "sustained injuries that thankfully weren't a lot more serious".

stories.title: Reward of £10,000 offered in hunt for sex attacker
stories.summary: Police are looking for a suspect who has targeted sex workers between October 2025 and September 2026.

stories.title: Warning of smaller Christmas trees after hot summer
stories.summary: Growers in Nottinghamshire say they will be left out of pocket because of fewer large trees to sell.

stories.title: Student union warns against self-swab 'rape kit' use
stories.summary: The kits, designed for sexual assault victims to gather their own evidence, have faced scrutiny.

stories.title: Man jailed for rape and abuse of woman
stories.summary: Nottinghamshire Police say the defendant "filmed himself committing offences".

stories.title: Police get £450k to target knife crime hotspots
stories.summary: The government cash will pay for extra patrols, increased CCTV coverage and early intervention work.

stories.title: Court action considered over derelict Debenhams
stories.summary: The landmark building in the heart of Nottingham has been repeatedly broken into by youths.
